Frequently asked questions

Explore our FAQ section to find answers about RazorpayX's business financial solutions

What is a current account?
A current account is a deposit account that allows account holders to manage everyday transactions and cash flow. Current accounts allow a significantly higher volume of transactions and specialized business finance services like bulk payouts, payroll and vendor management and more. This makes current accounts perfect for the banking needs of businesses, professionals and entrepreneurs.
What are digital current accounts?
A digital current account is a type of current account where businesses can digitally manage their finances. Today, all current accounts are digital - account holders can access their current account, make transactions and view account balances online via a mobile app or a dashboard.
What are the uses of a current account?
Opening a current account has significant benefits for businesses of all sizes. Current accounts help businesses and entrepreneurs manage their everyday banking needs. With a robust current account, you can make and receive high volumes of payments with no limit. You can also make use of various business banking features like overdraft facility, automated vendor management and payroll, bulk payouts and more.
What are the benefits of a current account?
Current accounts are very convenient for businesses to manage their finances since businesses have very specialized banking needs that cannot be fulfilled with a simple savings account. They allow businesses to make and receive payments, offer overdraft and credit facilities, as well as business services like vendor management, approval workflows, automated payroll and more.
What are the benefits of opening a current account online?
Online current accounts offer ease of access, flexibility and a wide range of products and services. The process of opening a current account online is also significantly easier and faster, and can be done from the comfort your home. Today, all businesses prefer digitally-enabled solutions like RazorpayX Business Banking+.
What are the different types of current account?
What is the eligibility criteria to open a current account?
What are the steps to open a RazorpayX powered current account online?
Unlike traditional banks, RazorpayX allows you to open a current account in these simple steps. Sign up here by providing email ID and creating a password for your account. Set up your account by providing your name, phone number, and GSTIN Sit back and relax! Our representative will contact you to verify your details.
What are the documents required to open a current account online?
What is Average Monthly Balance in current account and how is it calculated?
Monthly Average Balance is the minimum amount of money your current account should have on average in a month. calculated using two values: the sum of all closing balances in the month and the number of days in the month. The formula to calculate Monthly Average Balance (MAB) is: Monthly Average Balance (MAB) = Total end of the day closing balance / number of days in the month.
Is GST required to open current account online?
No, you do not need to register under the GST scheme or obtain a GST Identification Number (GSTIN) to open a current account. In fact, you need a functional current account to register under GST.
Can sole proprietor open current account online?
Yes! If you are a sole proprietor, you can open a current account online. For details on the documents you will need for KYC, check out our blog: Documents Required for Opening a Current Account.
What factors should you consider while opening a current account?
Is there any interest paid on current account?
Current accounts do not earn interest on the balance held in the account. This is because they are designed for easy access and frequent transactions, unlike savings accounts where funds are typically left untouched for longer periods. Current accounts offer other benefits, such as check writing, debit cards, and overdraft facilities.
Is current account taxable?
No, current accounts are not taxable since they are a no-interest account.
How can you transfer cash via current account?
What is the difference between a current account and a savings account?

  • A current account is used by businesses and high net-worth individuals. It supports high transaction volumes and offers specialized features such as corporate credit cards, internet banking, unlimited withdrawal, etc. Since a current account is intended for such large transaction volumes, it typically does not earn interest.

  • A savings account is meant to be used by individuals to store money and transact in limited volumes. Savings accounts earn interest on stored funds, and the minimum balance requirement is also lower than current accounts. 

    • What is the minimum balance requirement for a current account?
    Minimum balance requirements vary across banks and current account offerings. Current accounts with lower MAB requirements might not offer all the features as a current account with higher MAB requirements.
